title: Integrated Mission Safety & Pearl Noisy-OR Fusion
description: Welcome to ASTRA-GUARD. Rather than isolated warning indicators, ASTRA-GUARD synthesizes spacecraft bus health, orbital debris conjunction risk, and disaster intelligence into an explainable Mission Risk Score (0-100).
key_innovations: Pearl Noisy-OR probabilistic fusion: R_safety = 1 - (1 - r_h)(1 - r_d)
Strict Human-in-the-Loop advisory architecture: zero autonomous thruster burns
Explainable AI (XAI) feature attribution with non-causal sensitivity indicators

title: Subsystem Health AI & False-Alarm Suppression
description: Monitors EPS battery temperatures, bus voltages, thermal loops, and ADCS reaction wheels using calibrated neural autoencoders.
key_innovations: PyTorch LSTM Autoencoder with robust percentile scaling
Persistence Filter: suppresses transient spikes, cutting false alarms by 71.4% (25.6 vs 89.7 FA/day)
Channel-by-channel residual tracking across power, thermal, ADCS, and payload buses

title: Orbital Debris Risk & Conjunction Screening
description: Performs multi-stage conjunction assessment between Sentinel-2A and tracked space objects using SGP4 analytical propagation and 2-D B-plane math.
key_innovations: Hard Safety Override: Pc >= 1e-4 immediately triggers CRITICAL mission posture
XGBoost CDM Classifier trained on ESA Kelvins benchmark (1.00 ROC-AUC / 1.00 PR-AUC)

title: Ground-Segment Disaster Intelligence
description: Rapidly processes Earth Observation synthetic aperture radar (SAR) chips to identify flood extents and prioritize emergency observation downlink.
key_innovations: PyTorch U-Net flood segmentation: measured 0.9548 IoU, 0.9768 F1 on Sen1Floods11
Multi-factor prioritization score (severity, cloud penetration, confidence)
Cross-subsystem safety deferral: high spacecraft bus stress (r_h >= 0.50) defers heavy EO sensor slews

title: Alert Lifecycle, HITL Audit & Q2 Provenance
description: Manages operational alert lifecycles with strict deduplication, snooze cooldowns, human operator approval modals, and cryptographic auditability.
key_innovations: Operator action audit trail: immutable logs for approve, dismiss, and snooze events
Q2 Cryptographic Provenance: SHA-256 data window hash, config hash, and model manifest
Reproduce verification: re-evaluates inputs to verify bit-for-bit mathematical identity (score diff = 0.000000)

title: Day in the Life of Sentinel-2A Demo Player
description: Replays PRD §9's complete 4-scene operational arc: Nominal Orbit -> Battery Thermals -> Near-Miss Debris Conjunction -> Cyclone Flood Tasking.
key_innovations: Interactive Step, Seek, and Reset controls with live WebSocket broadcasting
100% deterministic replay verified across numerical scores and risk transitions
